# browser-mcp - llms-full.txt

Browser automation MCP server. Playwright-based page control (Chromium),
cross-browser bookmark management (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave),
and agentic browsing workflows. FastMCP 3.4 server, HTTP + stdio.

## Tools (17)

### Browser control (9 tools)
- `browse_page(url, headless?)` - Navigate to URL, extract visible text (20K cap)
- `click_element(selector, headless?)` - Click by CSS selector
- `extract_text(selector="body", headless?)` - Extract inner text
- `screenshot(headless?)` - Viewport PNG screenshot as base64
- `fill_input(selector, text, headless?)` - Type into input (clears first)
- `press_key(key, headless?)` - Press keyboard key (Enter, Tab, ArrowDown, ...)
- `close_browser()` - Release Playwright resources
- `list_browsers()` - Detect installed browsers + Firefox profiles
- `browse_url_cli(url, browser="chrome")` - Headless CLI mode (no Playwright)

### Bookmark management (portmanteau, 1 tool)
- `browser_bookmarks(operation, browser, ...)` - CRUD, search, sync, dedupe,
  tags, age analysis, broken-link check, export across
  chrome/firefox/edge/brave. Operations: list_bookmarks, get_bookmark,
  add_bookmark, edit_bookmark, delete_bookmark, search_bookmarks, sync_bookmarks,
  find_duplicates, find_old_bookmarks, find_forgotten_bookmarks,
  get_bookmark_stats, find_broken_links, list_tags, find_similar_tags,
  merge_tags, cleanup_tags, export_bookmarks

### Agentic workflows (4 tools)
- `browser_agent(task, headless?, max_steps?)` - LLM-driven browsing via browser-use (needs Ollama)
- `morning_briefing(config_name="default", headless?, max_pages?)` - Daily routine from conf/morning_pages.json
- `browse_items(items_json, task?, headless?, max_items?)` - Batch browse JSON list of links
- `browse_workflow(task, initial_url?, headless?, max_steps?)` - Logged multi-step browsing

### System (2 tools)
- `browser_help(topic="overview")` - Documentation lookup
- `browser_shutdown(confirm=false)` - Graceful shutdown (needs confirm=true)

### Prefab UI (1 tool, app=True)
- `show_browsers_card()` - Installed browsers as rich in-chat card

## API Endpoints (HTTP mode, port 10780)

- `GET /health` - Liveness, version, ports, uptime, tool count
- `GET /api/status` - Same payload as health
- `GET /api/capabilities` - Feature flags
- `GET /api/skills` - Skill listing (empty - no bundled skills)
- `GET /api/llm/discover` - Ollama/LM Studio provider probe
- `POST /api/llm/chat` - OpenAI-compatible chat proxy to local LLM
- `GET /api/fleet/webapps` - Fleet webapp discovery
- `POST /api/shutdown` - Graceful shutdown
- `GET /api/v1/diagnostics` - CUA smoke-test diagnostics
- `POST /mcp` - FastMCP streamable HTTP transport
- `GET /docs`, `/redoc` - Swagger UI / ReDoc

## Configuration

| Env | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `BROWSER_MCP_PORT` | `10780` | HTTP server port |
| `BROWSER_MCP_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Bind host |
| `BROWSER_MCP_HTTP_PATH` | `/mcp` | MCP path |
| `BROWSER_HEADLESS` | `true` | Default headless mode |
| `BROWSER_MCP_FRONTEND_PORT` | `10781` | Vite dev port |
| `LLM_BASE_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | LLM base for agent + chat |
| `LLM_MODEL` | `gemma4:12b` | Default model |
| `MCP_BRIDGE_URLS` | - | Comma-separated upstream MCP proxy URLs |
| `MCP_TRANSPORT` | - | `http` forces HTTP mode |

## Architecture

- `src/browser_mcp/server.py` - FastMCP instance + automation/system tools
- `src/browser_mcp/app.py` - FastAPI app (REST + `/mcp` mount)
- `src/browser_mcp/browser.py` - Playwright singleton lifecycle
- `src/browser_mcp/bookmarks/` - bookmark backends (chromium JSON, firefox sqlite)
- `src/browser_mcp/workflows/` - agentic tools
- `webapp/` - React + Vite + Tailwind dashboard (port 10781)
- `native/` - Tauri 2.0 wrapper, embedded PyInstaller backend

## Run

```powershell
uv sync && playwright install chromium
uv run python -m browser_mcp --serve   # HTTP on 10780
uv run browser-mcp                     # stdio (Claude Desktop)
.\start.ps1                            # backend + webapp + browser
```

## Notes

- Browser is a singleton per process; calls share page state until close_browser().
- Firefox bookmark writes need Firefox closed (reads fall back to DB copy).
- Tauri app: dashboard polls http://127.0.0.1:10780/health; backend spawned by the wrapper.
- All tools return `{"success": bool, ...}`; failures carry `error` + `error_type`.
